name: Fruit and Cream Cheese Breakfast Pastries
assumptions: Yield estimated from 2 puff pastry sheets cut into 9 squares each (18 total pastries).
Minutes is sum of ~15 min prep (mixing, rolling, cutting, filling) + 15-20 min bake time (using lower end of range).
Puff pastry assumed to contain wheat (standard composition).
Vanilla extract assumed alcohol-based, not containing allergens.
No compound sauces or ambiguous ingredients beyond noted assumptions.
Flour is for dusting only and does not change dietary classifications.
instructions:
Preheat oven to 400ºF (200ºC), and prepare two cookie sheets with parchment paper. In a bowl, mix cream cheese, sugar, and vanilla until fully combined. Lightly flour the surface and roll out puff pastry on top to flatten. Cut each sheet of puff pastry into 9 equal squares. On the top right and bottom left of the pastry, cut an L shape approximately ½ inch (1 cm) from the edge.
NOTE: This L shape should reach all the way down and across the square, however both L shapes should not meet at the ends. Your pastry should look like a picture frame with two corners still intact.
Take the upper right corner and fold down towards the inner bottom corner. You will now have a diamond shape.
Place 1 to 2 teaspoons of the cream cheese filling in the middle, then place berries on top.
Repeat with the remaining pastry squares and place them onto the parchment covered baking sheet.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until pastry is golden brown and puffed.
Enjoy!

ingredients.name: Cream Cheese
ingredients.assumptions: 1 1/4 oz (35g) full-fat cream cheese block; standard values for brick-style cream cheese

ingredients.name: Sugar
ingredients.assumptions: 1 1/4 cups granulated white sugar; standard 200g per cup density

ingredients.name: Vanilla Extract
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tsp vanilla extract; typical small volume for flavoring entire batch

ingredients.name: Flour
ingredients.assumptions: Light dusting of all-purpose flour on surface; small plausible amount for rolling out pastry without adding much to final product

ingredients.name: Puff Pastry
ingredients.assumptions: 2 standard 490g sheets of frozen puff pastry (e.g., Pepperidge Farm size), thawed and used fully

ingredients.name: Strawberries
ingredients.assumptions: Fresh strawberries, sliced or whole for topping; estimated total used across all 18 pastries based on 1-2 berries each

ingredients.name: Raspberries
ingredients.assumptions: Fresh raspberries for topping; estimated total used across all pastries based on 1-2 berries per square

ingredients.name: Blackberries
ingredients.assumptions: Fresh blackberries for topping; estimated total used across all pastries based on 1 berry per square
